The web original is React DOM over shadcn/ui with a single styling setup; this registry is universal React Native over RNR primitives, fanned from one source into two engine trees — nativewind, for Tailwind v3 projects, and uniwind, for Tailwind v4 — so the same item installs into either project as source compiled for its engine. This registry never publishes an npm package — distribution is the copy-paste registry alone, which is why the two engine trees exist.
